main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar move per short bet, in the short direction

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases grouped by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: a fall with t >= 2; reject: a rise with t <= -2; over at least 30 cases on at least 20 days

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of larger-|forecast| half minus smaller half (>= 0)

decided_by: The mean unusual move is a fall with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases on 20 days, and the supporting check passes.
reading: Profile taken from the regime column (bars not vetoed to 'chop') since its components are not recorded; the 5-day return and close location from the recorded fall5/highclose raw values, else from prices; cases are short bets only, first bet per 5-bar cell; day-clustered t with G/(G-1) correction; the |forecast| halves are the lower and upper n//2 cases by rank (middle case dropped when odd).

direction_check.why: main measure +0.01582 on the check folds against +0.02537 on every fold
